en: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David.

p.src: 1  May the LORD answer you in the day of trouble. May the name of the God of Jacob set you up on high,

en: May the LORD answer you in the day of trouble. May the name of the God of Jacob set you up on high,
u.src: 1  May the LORD answer you in the day of trouble. May the name of the God of Jacob set you up on high,

p.src: 2  send you help from the sanctuary, grant you support from Zion,

en: send you help from the sanctuary, grant you support from Zion,
u.src: 2  send you help from the sanctuary, grant you support from Zion,

p.src: 3  remember all your offerings, and accept your burned sacrifice. Selah.

en: remember all your offerings, and accept your burned sacrifice. Selah.
u.src: 3  remember all your offerings, and accept your burned sacrifice. Selah.

p.src: 4  May he grant you your heart’s desire, and fulfill all your counsel.

en: May he grant you your heart’s desire, and fulfill all your counsel.
u.src: 4  May he grant you your heart’s desire, and fulfill all your counsel.

p.src: 5  We will triumph in your salvation. In the name of our God, we will set up our banners. May the LORD grant all your requests.

en: We will triumph in your salvation. In the name of our God, we will set up our banners. May the LORD grant all your requests.
u.src: 5  We will triumph in your salvation. In the name of our God, we will set up our banners. May the LORD grant all your requests.

p.src: 6  Now I know that the LORD saves his anointed. He will answer him from his holy heaven, with the saving strength of his right hand.

en: Now I know that the LORD saves his anointed. He will answer him from his holy heaven, with the saving strength of his right hand.
u.src: 6  Now I know that the LORD saves his anointed. He will answer him from his holy heaven, with the saving strength of his right hand.

p.src: 7  Some trust in chariots, and some in horses, but we trust in the name of the LORD our God.

en: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses, but we trust in the name of the LORD our God.
u.src: 7  Some trust in chariots, and some in horses, but we trust in the name of the LORD our God.

p.src: 8  They are bowed down and fallen, but we rise up, and stand upright.

en: They are bowed down and fallen, but we rise up, and stand upright.
u.src: 8  They are bowed down and fallen, but we rise up, and stand upright.

p.src: 9  Save, LORD! Let the King answer us when we call!

en: Save, LORD! Let the King answer us when we call!
u.src: 9  Save, LORD! Let the King answer us when we call!
